description: The adidas Yeezy Slide Kids ‘Resin’ showcases a subtle monochromatic finish on a minimalist sandal constructed from lightweight EVA foam. title: YEEZY BOOST 380
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Hylte’ features an eye-catching color scheme that strays from the signature Yeezy palette, which traditionally leans heavily on muted earth tones. A splash of fluorescent green is applied to the the sneaker’s translucent monofilament window, contrasted by the camo-like tan and yellow composition that makes up the Primeknit upper. Standard Boost cushioning is enveloped in grey rubber and reinforced with a herringbone-traction outsole. The Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Hylte’ is a regional exclusive and only launched in North America and Latin America.
